summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser's compositing and layers capabilities introduce several improvements aimed at enhancing performance and supporting advanced visual features. Notably, these changes include the unification of NVImage formats (NV12/NV21 to I420) into a shared helper, streamlining the way images are processed. Furthermore, **support for HDR (High Dynamic Range) video surfaces** has been added, allowing for richer visuals with extended dynamic range, which is crucial for viewing high-quality video content. Additionally, the ability to batch scroll updates across different layers improves scrolling performance, making interactions feel smoother and more responsive for users. These enhancements not only bolster the browser's rendering capabilities but also lay the groundwork for richer multimedia experiences online.
